Bash(export MULTIOMICS_CONFIG=config/config_Amir_Sapir_test.yaml && Rscript -e '
library\(targets\)
prot_de <- tar_read\(prot_de_res\)
df <- prot_de$runs_de_tables[[1]][[1]]
cat\("Rownames head:", paste\(head\(rownames\(df\), 5\), collapse=", "\), "\\n"\)
cat\("Colnames:", paste\(colnames\(df\), collapse=", "\), "\\n"\)
cat\("Has P.Value:", "P.Value" %in% colnames\(df\), "\\n"\)
cat\("Has adj.P.Val:", "adj.P.Val" %in% colnames\(df\), "\\n"\)
cat\("Sig \(adj.P.Val<0.05\):", sum\(df$adj.P.Val < 0.05, na.rm=TRUE\), "\\n"\)
cat\("Sig \(P.Value<0.05\):", sum\(df$P.Value < 0.05, na.rm=TRUE\), "\\n"\)
')

Bash(export MULTIOMICS_CONFIG=config/config_Amir_Sapir_test.yaml && Rscript -e '
library\(targets\)
prot_pre <- tar_read\(prot_inputs\)
cat\("Names:", paste\(names\(prot_pre\), collapse=", "\), "\\n"\)
cat\("preprocessed_protein dim:", paste\(dim\(prot_pre$preprocessed_protein\), collapse=" x "\), "\\n"\)
cat\("preprocessed_protein rownames head:", paste\(head\(rownames\(prot_pre$preprocessed_protein\), 5\), collapse=", "\), "\\n"\)
if \(!is.null\(prot_pre$protein\)\) {
    cat\("protein dim:", paste\(dim\(prot_pre$protein\), collapse=" x "\), "\\n"\)  
    cat\("protein rownames head:", paste\(head\(rownames\(prot_pre$protein\), 5\), collapse=", "\), "\\n"\)
}
cat\("\\nmeta colnames:", paste\(colnames\(prot_pre$metadata\), collapse=", "\), "\\n"\)
')
